UCSI University - Faculty of Business and Management
MGT1013 Principles of Management
Group Assignment Brief

In groups of four, you will study how a Malaysian SME manages change. The assessment consists of a project proposal (15%), a written case study report (45%), a group presentation (30%) and a reflective log (10%).

All components must be submitted through CN (CourseNetworking) by the dates announced in class. Late work loses 10% of the marks per day.
